name: GKD Pixel 2
identify: helperFunctions.sh: /proc/cpuinfo part 0xd04 (RK3326) and no OS_NAME=DARKMOSS stamp in /etc/os-release (the dArkMoss branch, Pixel2DarkMoss, is picked only when that stamp is present)

pad.note: gamekiddy-joypad driver; node name not given by this cfg (no PAD_NAME_CANDIDATES), resolved purely by this by-path link

absent.L3: no L3/R3 and no Fn buttons on the Pixel 2 (tester 2026-11-12); twig Pixel2.cfg still lists B_L3/B_R3 317/318
absent.R3: no L3/R3 and no Fn buttons on the Pixel 2 (tester 2026-11-12); twig Pixel2.cfg still lists B_L3/B_R3 317/318
absent.HOME: cfg has no B_HOME at all (unlike Pixel2DarkMoss.cfg, which sets it to DOESNT_EXIST explicitly)
absent.LEFT_STICK: no analog stick (DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0); the cfg's STICK_* values are vestigial (see notes)
absent.FN_LEFT: the case's Fn keys are L3/R3 (1 317/1 318)
absent.FN_RIGHT: the case's Fn keys are L3/R3 (1 317/1 318)

notes: No analog stick (DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0), but unlike Pixel2DarkMoss.cfg (which sets STICK_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN=DOESNT_EXIST), this cfg still carries real-looking axis/magnitude values for all four (e.g. STICK_LEFT="3 0 -32767"). Treated as dead/vestigial copy-paste, not a real stick, consistent with DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0 and with the dArkMoss sibling cfg's cleaner DOESNT_EXIST.

B_L3/B_R3 (1 317/1 318) are present here with a comment that they "also log left/right fnkey stuff": the case's Fn keys and L3/R3 are the same physical buttons. This conflicts with Pixel2DarkMoss.cfg, which sets B_L3/B_R3=DOESNT_EXIST for the same physical GKD Pixel 2 hardware (same gamekiddy-joypad EVENT_PATH). Kept per this platform's own cfg; not reconciled.

SELECT/START/VOL_UP/VOL_DOWN each carry a secondary "_2" signal (B_SELECT_2=rctrl_pressed, B_START_2=enter_pressed, B_VOLUP_2="volume up", B_VOLDOWN_2="volume down"): these are getevent-style textual names helperFunctions.sh matches as a fallback, the same mechanism used on the oakMOSS MagicX boards (XU20/Zero28/Zero40) and the tina-stock/miyoomini platforms, not a second physical signal from the device.
This cfg exports no B_HOME at all (not even DOESNT_EXIST), unlike every dArkMoss platform cfg in this batch; treated as absent.
